camera.view_azimuth_source: computed: initial great-circle bearing from the camera position to the GNIS Mount Rainier summit point

sources.used_for: camera listed only as 'Paradise' ("Is the mountain out?"); building not stated
sources.note: The East, West and Visitor Center cams are stated to be at the Henry M. Jackson Memorial Visitor Center; this one is not, so the JVC position is an assumption.

sources.used_for: lat/lon of the Henry M. Jackson Memorial Visitor Center (GNIS feature 1984586, mirror of USGS GNIS; 5,390 ft)
cross-check: 'Mt Rainier- Jackson Visitor Ctr' monitor at 46.784100, -121.740303, 1615.9 m

sources.note: 442 m from the chosen position; the uncertainty radius covers the Paradise developed area

sources.used_for: ground elevation 1642.7 m (USGS 3DEP via EPQS); mount height above ground unknown

truth_camera.operator: National Park Service (Mount Rainier National Park)
truth_camera.ownership_basis: no ownership metadata in EXIF (Axis P1387); confirmation needed

sources.used_for: lat/lon: GNIS 1533614 'Mount Rainier' summit (Columbia Crest, GNIS 1517974, is 46.85282, -121.760388)
height: official 14,410 ft (4,392 m), USGS 1956 survey
sources.note: USGS 3DEP gives 4391.4 m at this point; a 2024 independent GNSS survey found Columbia Crest 21.8 ft lower than in 1998 and the SW rim now highest (14,406.2 ft NAVD88). Irrelevant at pixel scale from 7.7 km.

attribution: Webcam imagery courtesy National Park Service. Derived images are not NPS products.
notes: No NPS image archive exists for this camera. The NPS archive code 'mora' (from 2003-07-18) belongs to the Paradise air cam, which looks WSW and does not show the summit.
Night mode measured on one frame (2026-11-18 20:21 PST, ~/lookout-data/samples/mountain.jpg): monochrome, mean channel spread 0.01/255, mean luma 61.6.
EXIF carries DateTimeOriginal in local time plus TimeZoneOffset -8 and SubSecTimeOriginal; use snow_globe_common.images.exif_summary.
Update cadence undocumented; the 2026-11-19 stopgap saw a new Last-Modified at every 5-minute poll, so the 4-per-hour cap binds. Measure before filling interval_min_measured.
Faces a busy visitor area: people and vehicles must be blurred before any publication (PRD §15.1).
